hero.subtitle: Track vaccinations, manage health records, monitor pregnancies, and find the perfect breeding partner — all from one beautiful app.

features.title: Everything Your Pet Needs
features.subtitle: Comprehensive pet health management tools designed for modern pet parents and breeders.
features.vaccinationDesc: Never miss a vaccine. Get smart reminders and keep a complete immunization history for each pet.
features.recordsDesc: Digital health records with vet visits, surgeries, lab results, and medications all in one secure place.
features.pregnancyDesc: Track pregnancy milestones week by week, monitor weight changes, and prepare for delivery day.
features.matingDesc: Find verified breeding partners with health certifications, lineage info, and direct messaging.
features.schedulingDesc: Automated reminders for vet visits, medications, grooming, and vaccination boosters.
features.reportsDesc: Generate comprehensive PDF reports to share with vets, boarding facilities, or insurance providers.

howItWorks.title: Getting Started is Easy
howItWorks.subtitle: From download to full pet health management in under 2 minutes.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Get the app from App Store or Google Play. Sign up with email, Google, or Apple in seconds.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Add your pets with basic info — name, species, breed, and date of birth. Upload their photo.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Log vaccinations, set reminders, record vet visits, and explore the breeding marketplace.
